id: title:andehen:keep charts painted when their container collapses

review.posthog_relevance: Preserves chart rendering state and prevents unnecessary DOM updates when chart containers collapse or dimensions become invalid, supporting frontend performance and visual stability.
review.reason: The change implements a bounded, localized improvement to chart rendering behavior. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H2 add checks to detect zero or sub-pixel dimensions and suppress drawing, while P1.F2.H3 refines the repaint trigger condition. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement: preventing wasted rendering and preserving the last valid frame. No systemic risk or un
review.uncertainty: The benefit is demonstrated by the implementation, but the actual runtime performance gain and user experience improvement are not independently verified. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds a ResizeObserver callback and a wrapper size reporting helper, then uses them to detect when the wrapper size is zero and suppresses drawing.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the chart wrapper has collapsed to zero size and prevents drawing, preserving the last frame.

observations.behavior: Adds a deferredRepaint flag and a check for sub-pixel dimensions, returning early without drawing if width or height is less than 1.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the chart wrapper has collapsed to zero size and prevents drawing, preserving the last frame.

observations.behavior: Changes the condition for triggering a repaint from forceRepaint to repaint, and updates the state update condition to use repaint instead of forceRepaint.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the condition for triggering a repaint from forceRepaint to repaint, and updates the state update condition to use repaint instead of forceRepaint.
